panels.title: Usage · last 5 h
panels.description: Cost (cost_usd) per Claude account over the last 5 hours. Bar = that cost as % of the account's peak: its highest rolling 5-hour cost over the last 30 days (10-minute steps). Green below 60 %, yellow from 60 %, red from 80 %. Fixed windows: ignores the dashboard time range and the variables. Accounts with no cost in 7 days are not listed.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    concat(if(t.label = '', '(no account)', t.label), '  ·  $', toString(round(t.h5, 2))) AS name,
    round(100 * t.h5 / greatest(p.peak, t.h5, 0.000001)) AS pct
FROM
(
    SELECT account_uuid,
           argMax(account, ts) AS label,
           sumIf(cost_usd, ts >= now() - INTERVAL 5 HOUR) AS h5,
           sumIf(cost_usd, ts >= now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY) AS d7
    FROM cc.api_requests
    WHERE ts >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY
    GROUP BY account_uuid
) AS t
LEFT JOIN
(
    SELECT account_uuid, max(w) AS peak
    FROM
    (
        SELECT account_uuid,
               sum(c) OVER (PARTITION BY account_uuid ORDER BY b RANGE BETWEEN 17999 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS w
        FROM
        (
            SELECT account_uuid, toUInt32(toStartOfInterval(ts, INTERVAL 10 MINUTE)) AS b, sum(cost_usd) AS c
            FROM cc.api_requests
            WHERE ts >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY
            GROUP BY account_uuid, b
        )
    )
    GROUP BY account_uuid
) AS p ON p.account_uuid = t.account_uuid
WHERE t.d7 > 0
ORDER BY t.h5 DESC, t.d7 DESC

panels.title: Tips · 7 d
panels.description: Number of tips (view cc.tips, last 7 days). Click the value to open the Tips section of the Efficiency dashboard. Ignores the dashboard time range and the variables.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT count() AS tips
FROM cc.tips

panels.description: The most frequent tip category (view cc.tips, last 7 days) with its count in brackets (ties: alphabetical order). Click the value to open the Tips section of the Efficiency dashboard. Ignores the dashboard time range and the variables.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT if(tips = 0, 'none', concat(multiIf(top = 'cache', 'Cache rebuilds', top = 'repeated-read', 'Repeated reads', top = 'big-results', 'Big tool results', top = 'short-opus', 'Short Opus answers', top = 'agent-outlier', 'Costly agent run', top = 'denials', 'Denied tool calls', top = 'slow-hook', 'Slow hooks', top = 'slow-ttft', 'Slow first token', top), ' (', toString(n), ')')) AS most_frequent
FROM
(
    SELECT sum(c) AS tips,
           argMin(category, (-toInt64(c), category)) AS top,
           max(c) AS n
    FROM (SELECT category, count() AS c FROM cc.tips GROUP BY category)
)

panels.title: Latency, errors and hooks. Not about tokens, but they slow every turn.
panels.description: Every panel follows the time range and the Account, Project, Session, Actor and Skill variables, except the hook panels, which ignore Skill (hook events carry no skill). The rail on the left ignores them.

panels.title: TTFT mean
panels.description: Mean time to first token (ttft_ms of the model requests that streamed; requests without it are skipped); the second line is the 95th percentile. Red above 3 s, the threshold of the slow-ttft tip.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT avg(ttft_ms) AS mean_ms, concat('p95 ', toString(round(quantile(0.95)(ttft_ms) / 1000, 1)), ' s') AS name
FROM cc.api_requests WHERE ttft_ms > 0 AND ('__all' IN (${account:singlequote}) OR account_uuid IN (${account:singlequote})) AND ('${project}' = '__all' OR project = '${project}') AND ('${session}' = '__all' OR session_id = '${session}') AND ('${actor}' = '__all' OR actor = '${actor}') AND ('${skill}' = '__all' OR skill = '${skill}') AND $__timeFilter(ts)
HAVING count() > 0

panels.title: API latency p95
panels.description: 95th percentile of the total duration of a model request (duration_ms of api_request), all models together.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT quantile(0.95)(duration_ms) AS p95_ms, 'all models' AS name
FROM cc.api_requests WHERE ('__all' IN (${account:singlequote}) OR account_uuid IN (${account:singlequote})) AND ('${project}' = '__all' OR project = '${project}') AND ('${session}' = '__all' OR session_id = '${session}') AND ('${actor}' = '__all' OR actor = '${actor}') AND ('${skill}' = '__all' OR skill = '${skill}') AND $__timeFilter(ts)
HAVING count() > 0

panels.title: API errors
panels.description: api_error events (every failed attempt of a model request, retries included) as a share of the model requests (api_request events) in the time range. The Actor and Skill variables are matched through the agent and the skill of the failed request.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT 100 * errs / greatest(reqs, 1) AS error_rate, concat(toString(errs), ' of ', toString(reqs), ' requests') AS name
FROM
(
    SELECT
        (SELECT count() FROM
            (
                SELECT e.ts AS ts, e.account_uuid AS account_uuid, e.project AS project, e.session_id AS session_id, e.skill_name AS skill,
                       multiIf(e.agent_id != '', if(a.agent = '', 'agent?', a.agent), e.query_source IN ('sdk', 'main') OR startsWith(e.query_source, 'repl_main'), 'main', concat('aux:', e.query_source)) AS actor
                FROM cc.events AS e LEFT JOIN cc.agents AS a ON a.agent_id = e.agent_id
                WHERE e.event = 'api_error' AND $__timeFilter(e.ts)
            )
            WHERE ('__all' IN (${account:singlequote}) OR account_uuid IN (${account:singlequote})) AND ('${project}' = '__all' OR project = '${project}') AND ('${session}' = '__all' OR session_id = '${session}') AND ('${actor}' = '__all' OR actor = '${actor}') AND ('${skill}' = '__all' OR skill = '${skill}')) AS errs,
        (SELECT count() FROM cc.api_requests WHERE ('__all' IN (${account:singlequote}) OR account_uuid IN (${account:singlequote})) AND ('${project}' = '__all' OR project = '${project}') AND ('${session}' = '__all' OR session_id = '${session}') AND ('${actor}' = '__all' OR actor = '${actor}') AND ('${skill}' = '__all' OR skill = '${skill}') AND $__timeFilter(ts)) AS reqs
)

panels.title: Hook time
panels.description: Total time spent in your hooks (hook_execution_complete events): hooks run synchronously and delay the tool call they belong to. The second line is the number of runs. The Skill variable is ignored: hook events carry no skill.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT sum(hook_duration_ms) AS total_ms, concat(toString(count()), ' runs · all hooks') AS name
FROM
(
    SELECT e.ts AS ts, e.account_uuid AS account_uuid, e.project AS project, e.session_id AS session_id, e.hook_duration_ms AS hook_duration_ms,
           if(e.agent_id = '', 'main', if(a.agent = '', 'agent?', a.agent)) AS actor
    FROM cc.events AS e LEFT JOIN cc.agents AS a ON a.agent_id = e.agent_id
    WHERE e.event = 'hook_execution_complete' AND e.hook_name != '' AND $__timeFilter(e.ts)
)
WHERE ('__all' IN (${account:singlequote}) OR account_uuid IN (${account:singlequote})) AND ('${project}' = '__all' OR project = '${project}') AND ('${session}' = '__all' OR session_id = '${session}') AND ('${actor}' = '__all' OR actor = '${actor}')

panels.title: Time to first token by day
panels.description: Mean ttft_ms per day and model family (requests without ttft_ms are skipped). The dashed red line is 3 s, the threshold of the slow-ttft tip (it uses the mean per project and model). Days are in server time (UTC). Target of the slow-ttft tip.

panels.title: Hook time
panels.description: Per hook (hook_execution_complete events): runs, mean and total duration. Hooks run synchronously and delay the tool call they belong to. Mean above 200 ms is yellow, above 500 ms red (the slow-hook tip fires at 500 ms and 10 runs in 7 days). Sorted by Mean. The Skill variable is ignored: hook events carry no skill. Target of the slow-hook tip.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT hook_name AS hook, count() AS runs, avg(hook_duration_ms) AS mean_ms, sum(hook_duration_ms) AS total_ms
FROM
(
    SELECT e.ts AS ts, e.account_uuid AS account_uuid, e.project AS project, e.session_id AS session_id, e.hook_name AS hook_name, e.hook_duration_ms AS hook_duration_ms,
           if(e.agent_id = '', 'main', if(a.agent = '', 'agent?', a.agent)) AS actor
    FROM cc.events AS e LEFT JOIN cc.agents AS a ON a.agent_id = e.agent_id
    WHERE e.event = 'hook_execution_complete' AND e.hook_name != '' AND $__timeFilter(e.ts)
)
WHERE ('__all' IN (${account:singlequote}) OR account_uuid IN (${account:singlequote})) AND ('${project}' = '__all' OR project = '${project}') AND ('${session}' = '__all' OR session_id = '${session}') AND ('${actor}' = '__all' OR actor = '${actor}')
GROUP BY hook_name ORDER BY mean_ms DESC

panels.title: API errors
panels.description: Failed model requests (api_error events) per HTTP status and error text (first 100 characters), with the time of the last one. Status 429 and above are red, below yellow; a dash means an error without an HTTP status (e.g. a network error). Sorted by Count, 50 rows at most.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT status_code AS status, leftUTF8(error, 100) AS message, count() AS n, max(ts) AS last_seen
FROM
(
    SELECT e.ts AS ts, e.account_uuid AS account_uuid, e.project AS project, e.session_id AS session_id, e.skill_name AS skill, e.status_code AS status_code, e.error AS error,
           multiIf(e.agent_id != '', if(a.agent = '', 'agent?', a.agent), e.query_source IN ('sdk', 'main') OR startsWith(e.query_source, 'repl_main'), 'main', concat('aux:', e.query_source)) AS actor
    FROM cc.events AS e LEFT JOIN cc.agents AS a ON a.agent_id = e.agent_id
    WHERE e.event = 'api_error' AND $__timeFilter(e.ts)
)
WHERE ('__all' IN (${account:singlequote}) OR account_uuid IN (${account:singlequote})) AND ('${project}' = '__all' OR project = '${project}') AND ('${session}' = '__all' OR session_id = '${session}') AND ('${actor}' = '__all' OR actor = '${actor}') AND ('${skill}' = '__all' OR skill = '${skill}')
GROUP BY status, message ORDER BY n DESC, last_seen DESC LIMIT 50

panels.title: API request duration
panels.description: Model requests by total duration (duration_ms of api_request). Bars are green below 5 s, yellow to 10 s, orange to 20 s, red above.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT ['< 2 s', '2–5 s', '5–10 s', '10–20 s', '20–60 s', '> 60 s'][b.lvl + 1] AS bucket, ifNull(r.requests, 0) AS requests, b.lvl AS level
FROM (SELECT arrayJoin([0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5]) AS lvl) AS b
LEFT JOIN
(
    SELECT lvl, count() AS requests
    FROM
    (
        SELECT multiIf(duration_ms < 2000, 0, duration_ms < 5000, 1, duration_ms < 10000, 2, duration_ms < 20000, 3, duration_ms < 60000, 4, 5) AS lvl
        FROM cc.api_requests WHERE ('__all' IN (${account:singlequote}) OR account_uuid IN (${account:singlequote})) AND ('${project}' = '__all' OR project = '${project}') AND ('${session}' = '__all' OR session_id = '${session}') AND ('${actor}' = '__all' OR actor = '${actor}') AND ('${skill}' = '__all' OR skill = '${skill}') AND $__timeFilter(ts)
    )
    GROUP BY lvl
) AS r ON r.lvl = b.lvl
ORDER BY b.lvl
